data.desc: Manulife Bank, established in 1993, was the first federally regulated bank opened by an insurance company in Canada. Manulife Bank delivers banking solutions designed to make financial decisions easier and unlock greater possibilities for better financial outcomes. Through its partnerships with independent financial advisors and mortgage brokers across Canada, the Bank helps Canadians achieve their broader financial goals. Manulife Bank is a Schedule I federally chartered bank, a wholly owned subsidiary of The Manufacturers Life Insurance Company, and part of the Manulife Financial Corporation group. A member of the Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation (CDIC), the Bank offers a full range of banking, lending and credit solutions, including everyday banking, high-interest deposit accounts, customizable mortgage solutions, specialized lending, and credit cards.
